eta_fund * Eq_HC_B[t - 1] + (1 - eta_fund) * transitionend * (mshare[t] < 1) * (max(0.0, 1 - mshare[t] + lambda_HC1 * re_BG[t] + lambda_HC2 * re_EqLC[t] + lambda_HC3 * re_EqHC[t] + lambda_HC4 * re_SEC[t]) * Funds_B[t])
eta_fund * Eq_HC_B[t - 1] + (1 - eta_fund) * transitionend * (mshare[t - 1] < 1) * max(0.0, min(1, 1 - mshare[t] + lambda_HC2B * re_EqLC[t] + lambda_HC3B * re_EqHC[t])) * Funds_B[t]

eta_fund * Eq_HC_B[t - 1] + (1 - eta_fund) * transitionend * (mshare[t - 1] < 1) * max(0.0, min(1, 1 - mshare[t] + lambda_HC2B * re_EqLC[t] + lambda_HC3B * re_EqHC[t])) * Funds_B[t]

eta_fund * Eq_HC_B[t - 1] + (1 - eta_fund) * transitionend * (mshare[t - 1] < 1) * (max(0.0, 1 - mshare[t] + lambda_HC1 * re_BG[t] + lambda_HC2 * re_EqLC[t] + lambda_HC3 * re_EqHC[t] + lambda_HC4 * re_SEC[t]) * Funds_B[t])

Eq_LC.expr: eta_fund * Eq_LC[t - 1] + (1 - eta_fund) * max(0.0, max(0.0, min(1, lambda_LC0[t] + lambda_LC1 * re_BG[t] + lambda_LC2 * re_EqLC[t] + lambda_LC3 * re_EqHC[t] + lambda_LC4 * re_SEC[t])) * Funds[t] * 1 / (1 + 0 * (illiq_NBFI[t - 1] - illiq_NBFI_bar)))

Eq_LC_B.expr: eta_fund * Eq_LC_B[t - 1] + (1 - eta_fund) * max(0.0, max(0.0, min(1, mshare[t] + lambda_LC2B * re_EqLC[t] + lambda_LC3B * re_EqHC[t])) * Funds_B[t])
eta_fund * Eq_LC_B[t - 1] + (1 - eta_fund) * max(0.0, max(0.0, min(1, mshare[t] + lambda_LC2B * re_EqLC[t] + lambda_LC3B * re_EqHC[t])) * Funds_B[t])
eta_fund * Eq_LC_B[t - 1] + (1 - eta_fund) * max(0.0, max(0.0, min(1, mshare[t] + lambda_LC2B * re_EqLC[t] + lambda_LC3B * re_EqHC[t])) * Funds_B[t])

H_HC.expr: 0 * int(1 - S_LCLC[t] > 0) * int(Dep_HC[t] + RE_HC[t] - Rep_HC[t] < 0) * (Rep_HC[t] - (Dep_HC[t] + RE_HC[t]))

int(Invc_LC[t] - Invd_LC[t] < 0) * Invc_LC[t] + int(Invc_LC[t] - Invd_LC[t] >= 0) * Invd_LC[t]

gva_KLC.expr: ((Inv_LC[t] + Inv_LCHC[t]) / p_KLC[t] - (Inv_LC[t - 1] + Inv_LCHC[t - 1]) / p_KLC[t - 1]) / ((Inv_LC[t - 1] + Inv_LCHC[t - 1]) / p_KLC[t - 1])

illiq_HC.expr: (efee[t] * (e[t - 1] / e[t] - 1) * P[t] + Kcost_HC[t] + decomfee[t - 1] + T_HC[t] + T_C[t] + altmod * (Inv_HC[t] + Inv_LCHC[t] + Conv[t] - natdepswitch * (Natdep_LCHC[t] + Natdep_HC[t])) + Div_HC[t] + w[t] * N_HC[t]) / (X_HC[t] + NL_HC[t] + tau_HC[t] + H_HC[t] + i_Dep[t] * Dep_HC[t - 1] + p_EqHC[t] * (eq_HC[t] - eq_HC[t - 1]) + 0 * (Dep_HC[t] - Dep_HC[t - 1]))

(Kcost_HC[t] + T_HC[t] + decomfee[t - 1] + T_C[t] + altmod * (Inv_HC[t] + Inv_LCHC[t] + Conv[t] - natdepswitch * (Natdep_LCHC[t] + Natdep_HC[t])) + Div_HC[t] + w[t] * N_HC[t]) / (X_HC[t] + NL_HC[t] + tau_HC[t] + H_HC[t] + i_Dep[t] * Dep_HC[t - 1] + p_EqHC[t] * (eq_HC[t] - eq_HC[t - 1]) + 0 * (Dep_HC[t] - Dep_HC[t - 1]))

illiq_LC.expr: (Kcost_LC[t] + T_LC[t] + altmod * (Inv_LC[t] - natdepswitch * Natdep_LC[t]) + Div_LC[t] + w[t] * N_LC[t]) / (X_LC[t] + NL_LC[t] + tau_LC[t] + H_LC[t] + i_Dep[t] * Dep_LC[t - 1] + p_EqLC[t] * (eq_LC[t] - eq_LC[t - 1]) + 0 * (Dep_LC[t] - Dep_LC[t - 1]))

illiq_NBFI.expr: (Kcost_NBFI[t] + U_pay[t] + altmod * (p_EqHC[t] * (1 - shareB_HC[t]) * (eq_HC[t] - eq_HC[t - 1]) + p_EqLC[t] * (1 - shareB_LC[t]) * (eq_LC[t] - eq_LC[t - 1]) + (B_GNBFI[t] - B_GNBFI[t - 1]))) / (Pi_NBFI[t] + NL_NBFI[t] + H_NBFI[t] + 0 * (Dep_NBFI[t] - Dep_NBFI[t - 1]) + 0 * CG_U[t - 1] + uswitch * (U[t] - U[t - 1]))

kcost_SEC_HC.expr: (NL_HC[t] * i_LHC[t] / (1 - (1 + i_LHC[t]) ** (-M)) + H_HC[t] * ((theta_M > 1) * 0.5 + (theta_M == 1)) * i_LHC[t] / (1 - (1 + i_LHC[t]) ** (-M / theta_M))) * z[t]

kcost_SEC_LC.expr: (NL_LC[t] * i_LLC[t] / (1 - (1 + i_LLC[t]) ** (-M)) + H_LC[t] * ((theta_M > 1) * 0.5 + (theta_M == 1)) * i_LLC[t] / (1 - (1 + i_LLC[t]) ** (-M / theta_M))) * z[t]

kstockT_HC.expr: (1 - mshare[t]) * (1 + g_hc[t - 1]) * x_HC[t - 1] / (uTHC * kappa_HC) + mshare[t] * SD_HC[t] * kstockT_X[t]

kstockT_LC.expr: max(0, kstockT_X[t] - (kstockT_HC[t] - conv_d[t] - (AS_HC_del[t] - conv_d[t])) - (kstock_LCHC[t] + conv_d[t] + invd_LCHC[t]))

lambda_HC0.expr: lambda_HC0[t - 1] * eta_port + (1 - eta_port) * ((1 - lambda_BG0[t - 1]) * p_EqHC_hat[t] * (eq_HC[t - 1] / eq_HC[t - 2]) * eq_HC[t - 1] / (p_EqHC_hat[t] * eq_HC[t - 1] * (eq_HC[t - 1] / eq_HC[t - 2]) + p_EqLC_hat[t] * eq_LC[t - 1] * (eq_LC[t - 1] / eq_LC[t - 2])))

lambda_KHC.expr: max(0, (1 + kaldor * (eta_kaldor * g_va[t - 1] + (1 - eta_kaldor) * max(-1, gva_KHC[t - 1] / (1 + gva_KHC[t - 1])))) * lambda_KHC[t - 1])

lambda_KLC.expr: max(0, (1 + kaldor * (eta_kaldor * g_va[t - 1] + (1 - eta_kaldor) * max(-1, gva_KLC[t - 1] / (1 + gva_KLC[t - 1])))) * lambda_KLC[t - 1])

lambda_LC0.expr: lambda_LC0[t - 1] * eta_port + (1 - eta_port) * ((1 - lambda_BG0[t - 1]) * p_EqLC_hat[t] * (eq_LC[t - 1] / eq_LC[t - 2]) * eq_LC[t - 1] / (p_EqHC_hat[t] * eq_HC[t - 1] * (eq_HC[t - 1] / eq_HC[t - 2]) + p_EqLC_hat[t] * eq_LC[t - 1] * (eq_LC[t - 1] / eq_LC[t - 2])))

mu_LHC.expr: max(0, mubar + (1 - (t >= start) * res_coef * resistance_B) * sigma_HC * mshare[t] + sigma_NPL * (1 - 1 / (1 + (lev_HC[t - 1] - lev_HC_bar[t]))))

mu_LLC.expr: max(0, mubar + sigma_LC * (1 - mshare[t]) * (1 + (t >= start) * res_coef * resistance_B) + sigma_NPL * (1 - 1 / (1 + (lev_LC[t - 1] - lev_LC_bar[t]))))

mu_X.expr: max(0, mu_X[t - 1] - min(0, eta_mu * (pinet_X[t - 1] - (Rep_X[t - 1] + Rep_SEC_X[t - 1]) / X[t - 1] - pinetrepXT[t])) + nu_u * (u_X[t - 1] - uTHC_star[t]))

nu.expr: (nu[0] > 0) * max(0, nu[t - 1] * (1 + (t >= kickstart) * beta_nu * 10 * (CG_NBFI[t - 1] / U[t - 1] - CG_bar)))

omega_conv.expr: min(1, xi_inv * convswitch * max(0, BSloss_HC[t] / (p_conv[t] * AS_HC_del[t])))

p_EqHC_hat.expr: 1 / hindsight * sum(divShare_HC[t - (hindsight + 1):t - 1]) / (1 + sum(r_EqHC[t - (hindsight + 1):t - 1]) / hindsight - min(sum(r_EqHC[t - (hindsight + 1):t - 1]) / hindsight + 0.99, max(0, divShare_HC[t - 1] / divShare_HC[t - (hindsight + 1)]) ** (1 / hindsight)))
p_EqHC_hat[t - 1] if len(p_EqHC_hat) > t - 1 else p_EqHC_hat[-1]

p_EqLC_hat.expr: 1 / hindsight * sum(divShare_LC[t - (hindsight + 1):t - 1]) / (1 + sum(r_EqLC[t - (hindsight + 1):t - 1]) / hindsight - min(sum(r_EqLC[t - (hindsight + 1):t - 1]) / hindsight + 0.99, max(0, divShare_LC[t - 1] / divShare_LC[t - (hindsight + 1)]) ** (1 / hindsight)))
p_EqLC_hat[t - 1] if len(p_EqLC_hat) > t - 1 else p_EqLC_hat[-1]

p_X.expr: (1 + mu_X[t] + (1 - S_LCHCHC[t - 1]) * (1 - mshare[t - 1]) * passthrough * theta_c[t] * e[t] / UC_X[t]) * UC_X[t]

phi_NPL_HC.expr: phi_max / (1 + phi0 * np.exp(phi1 - phi2 * illiq_HC[t - 1] - phi3 * lev_HC[t - 1]))

phi_NPL_LC.expr: phi_max / (1 + phi0 * np.exp(phi1 - phi2 * illiq_LC[t - 1] - phi3 * lev_LC[t - 1]))

phi_NPL_NBFI.expr: bubble * phi_max / (1 + phi0 * np.exp(phi1_NBFI - phi2 * illiq_NBFI[t - 1] - phi3 * lev_NBFI[t - 1]))

psi_HC.expr: max(0.05, min(1.0, psi_HC[t - 1] - 0 * 0.01 * (p_EqHC[t - 1] / p_EqHC[t - 2] - 1) - 0 * 0.25 * (Iota_HC[t] / Pi_HC[t] / (Iota_HC[t - 1] / Pi_HC[t - 1]) - 1) + 0 * beta_psi_tob_HC * max(0, 1 - TobHC[t])))

max(0.05, min(1.0, psi_HC[t - 1] - 0 * 0.05 * (p_EqHC[t - 1] / p_EqHC[t - 2] - 1) - 0 * 0.25 * (Iota_HC[t] / Pi_HC[t] / (Iota_HC[t - 1] / Pi_HC[t - 1]) - 1) + 0 * beta_psi_tob_HC * max(0, 1 - TobHC[t])))

psi_LC.expr: max(0.05, min(1.0, psi_LC[t - 1] - 0 * 0.01 * (p_EqLC[t - 1] / p_EqLC[t - 2] - 1) - 0 * 0.25 * (Iota_LC[t] / Pi_LC[t] / (Iota_LC[t - 1] / Pi_LC[t - 1]) - 1)) + 0 * beta_psi_tob_LC * max(0, 1 - TobLC[t]))

max(0.05, min(1.0, psi_LC[t - 1] - 0 * 0.05 * (p_EqLC[t - 1] / p_EqLC[t - 2] - 1) - 0 * 0.25 * (Iota_LC[t] / Pi_LC[t] / (Iota_LC[t - 1] / Pi_LC[t - 1]) - 1) + 0 * beta_psi_tob_LC * max(0, 1 - TobLC[t])))

re_EqHC.expr: (r_EqHC[t - 1] + eta_re * (r_EqHC[t - 1] - re_EqHC[t - 1]) + tob_prem * (1 - TobHC[t])) * (1 + (t >= start) * res_coef * resistance_NBFI * (1 - mshare[t - 1]))

re_EqLC.expr: (S_LCLC[t] > 0) * (r_EqLC[t - 1] + eta_re * (r_EqLC[t - 1] - re_EqLC[t - 1]) + tob_prem * (1 - TobLC[t])) * (1 - (t >= start) * res_coef * resistance_NBFI * (1 - mshare[t - 1]))

tau_H[t].expr: T[t] + Pi_CB[t] - (B_G[t - 1] + i_BG[t] * B_G[t - 1] + G[t] + tau_HC[t] + tau_LC[t] + buffer[t] + recycling * T_C[t])
T[t] + Pi_CB[t] - (B_G[t - 1] - B_G[t] + i_BG[t] * B_G[t - 1] + G[t] + tau_HC[t] + tau_LC[t] + buffer[t] + recycling * T_C[t])

transfer.expr: transfer_switch * x_LC[t] * ((1 - mshare[t - 1]) * passthrough * theta_c[t] * e[t] / UC_X[t]) * UC_X[t]

varpi_HC.expr: varpi_max * (1 - (t >= start) * res_coef * resistance_B * (1 - mshare[t - 1])) / (1 + varpi0 * np.exp(varpi1 - varpi2 * dsr_HC[t - 1] + varpi3 * (CAR[t - 1] - 0.18)))

varpi_LC.expr: varpi_max * (1 + (t >= start) * res_coef * resistance_B * (1 - mshare[t - 1])) / (1 + varpi0 * np.exp(varpi1 - varpi2 * dsr_LC[t - 1] + varpi3 * (CAR[t - 1] - 0.18)))

varpi_NBFI.expr: varpi_max_NBFI / (1 + varpi0 * np.exp(varpi1 - varpi2 * dsr_NBFI[t - 1] + varpi3 * (CAR[t - 1] - 0.18)))

varpi_tot.expr: varpi_HC[t] * L_HC[t] / L[t] + varpi_LC[t] * L_LC[t] / L[t] + varpi_NBFI[t] * L_NBFI[t] / L[t]

w.expr: w[t - 1] * (1 + gw0 * CPI_inf[t - 1] + gw1 * g_va[t - 1] - 0 * (emprate[t - 1] - emprate[t - 2]))

xiDiv_HC.expr: min(1, max(0, xiDiv_HC[t - 1] * (1 + (t >= kickstart) * (-(1 - xiDiv_HC[t - 1]) * (illiq_HC[t - 1] - illiqHCbar)))))

xiDiv_LC.expr: min(1, max(0, xiDiv_LC[t - 1] * (1 + (t >= kickstart) * (-(1 - xiDiv_LC[t - 1]) * (illiq_LC[t - 1] - illiqLCbar)))))

xi_B.expr: min(1, max(0, 1 - (0.18 * (L[t] + Eq_HC_B[t] + Eq_LC_B[t]) - OF[t - 1] + NPL[t] - (eq_HC[t - 1] * shareB_HC[t - 1] * (p_EqHC[t] - p_EqHC[t - 1]) + eq_LC[t - 1] * shareB_LC[t - 1] * (p_EqLC[t] - p_EqLC[t - 1]))) / Pi_B[t]))

eta_bank[t] * xi_B[t - 1] + (1 - eta_bank[t]) * min(1, max(0, 1 - (0.18 * (L[t] + Eq_HC_B[t] + Eq_LC_B[t]) - OF[t - 1] + NPL[t] - (eq_HC[t - 1] * shareB_HC[t - 1] * (p_EqHC[t] - p_EqHC[t - 1]) + eq_LC[t - 1] * shareB_LC[t - 1] * (p_EqLC[t] - p_EqLC[t - 1]))) / Pi_B[t]))

xi_FundsBbar.expr: (t < kickstart) * xi_FundsB + (t >= kickstart) * xi_FundsB * (1 - (0.18 - CAR[t - 1]) * beta_fundsB / (1 + np.exp(-varpi3 * (CAR[t - 1] - 0.18))))
